title: Trading Volume and Arbitrage
one_line: Builds on Lo & Wang to decompose trading volume into market-wide and stock-specific parts, with a model of 'liquidity arbitrageurs' and a screening tool for practitioners, illustrated on FTSE data 2000-2002.

findings.statement: Volume decomposition with a theoretical justification (liquidity arbitrageurs).
